ClientMatch.description:
Criteria for matching clients.

If no fields are set, all clients are matched. If multiple fields are set, all fields
must match the client.

name.description:
Matches if the client rule with this name matches.

- Example:

  ```toml
  [[clients]]
  name = "spotify"
  match.sandbox-app-id = "com.spotify.Client"

  # Matches the same clients as the previous rule.
  [[clients]]
  match.name = "spotify"
  ```

not.description:
Matches if the contained criteria don't match.

- Example:

  ```toml
  [[clients]]
  name = "not-spotify"
  match.not.sandbox-app-id = "com.spotify.Client"
  ```

all.description:
Matches if all of the contained criteria match.

- Example:

  ```toml
  [[clients]]
  match.all = [
    { sandbox-app-id = "com.spotify.Client" },
    { sandbox-engine = "org.flatpak" },
  ]
  ```

any.description:
Matches if any of the contained criteria match.

- Example:

  ```toml
  [[clients]]
  match.any = [
    { sandbox-app-id = "com.spotify.Client" },
    { sandbox-app-id = "com.valvesoftware.Steam" },
  ]
  ```

exactly.description:
Matches if a specific number of contained criteria match.

- Example:

  ```toml
  # Matches any client that is either steam or sandboxed by flatpak but not both.
  [[clients]]
  match.exactly.num = 1
  match.exactly.list = [
    { sandbox-engine = "org.flatpak" },
    { sandbox-app-id = "com.valvesoftware.Steam" },
  ]
  ```

sandboxed.description:
Matches if the client is/isn't sandboxed.

- Example:

  ```toml
  [[clients]]
  match.sandboxed = true
  ```

sandbox-engine.description:
Matches the engine name of the client's sandbox verbatim.

- Example:

  ```toml
  [[clients]]
  match.sandbox-engine = "org.flatpak"
  ```

sandbox-engine-regex.description:
Matches the engine name of the client's sandbox with a regular expression.

- Example:

  ```toml
  [[clients]]
  match.sandbox-engine = "flatpak"
  ```

sandbox-app-id.description:
Matches the app id of the client's sandbox verbatim.

- Example:

  ```toml
  [[clients]]
  match.sandbox-app-id = "com.spotify.Client"
  ```

sandbox-app-id-regex.description:
Matches the app id of the client's sandbox with a regular expression.

- Example:

  ```toml
  [[clients]]
  match.sandbox-app-id-regex = "(?i)spotify"
  ```

sandbox-instance-id.description: Matches the instance id of the client's sandbox verbatim.

sandbox-instance-id-regex.description: Matches the instance id of the client's sandbox with a regular expression.

uid.description: Matches the user ID of the client.

pid.description: Matches the process ID of the client.

is-xwayland.description: Matches if the client is/isn't Xwayland.

comm.description: Matches the `/proc/pid/comm` of the client verbatim.

comm-regex.description: Matches the `/proc/pid/comm` of the client with a regular expression.

exe.description: Matches the `/proc/pid/exe` of the client verbatim.

exe-regex.description: Matches the `/proc/pid/exe` of the client with a regular expression.

tag.description: Matches the tag of the client verbatim.

tag-regex.description: Matches the tag of the client with a regular expression.

ClientMatchExactly.description: Criterion for matching a specific number of client criteria.

num.description: The number of criteria that must match.

anyOf.description: An array of masks that are OR'd.

WindowMatch.description:
Criteria for matching windows.

If no fields are set, all windows are matched. If multiple fields are set, all fields
must match the window.

name.description:
Matches if the window rule with this name matches.

- Example:

  ```toml
  [[windows]]
  name = "spotify"
  match.title-regex = "Spotify"

  # Matches the same windows as the previous rule.
  [[windows]]
  match.name = "spotify"
  ```

not.description:
Matches if the contained criteria don't match.

- Example:

  ```toml
  [[windows]]
  name = "not-spotify"
  match.not.title-regex = "Spotify"
  ```

all.description:
Matches if all of the contained criteria match.

- Example:

  ```toml
  [[windows]]
  match.all = [
    { title-regex = "Spotify" },
    { title-regex = "Premium" },
  ]
  ```

any.description:
Matches if any of the contained criteria match.

- Example:

  ```toml
  [[windows]]
  match.any = [
    { title-regex = "Spotify" },
    { title-regex = "Alacritty" },
  ]
  ```

exactly.description:
Matches if a specific number of contained criteria match.

- Example:

  ```toml
  # Matches any window that is either Alacritty or on workspace 3 but not both.
  [[windows]]
  match.exactly.num = 1
  match.exactly.list = [
    { workspace = "3" },
    { title-regex = "Alacritty" },
  ]
  ```

types.description: Matches windows whose type is contained in the mask.

client.description: Matches if the window's client matches the client criterion.

title.description: Matches the title of the window verbatim.

title-regex.description: Matches the title of the window with a regular expression.

app-id.description: Matches the app-id of the window verbatim.

app-id-regex.description: Matches the app-id of the window with a regular expression.

floating.description: Matches if the window is/isn't floating.

visible.description: Matches if the window is/isn't visible.

urgent.description: Matches if the window has/hasn't the urgency flag set.

focused.description: Matches if the window has/hasn't the keyboard focus.

fullscreen.description: Matches if the window is/isn't fullscreen.

just-mapped.description:
Matches if the window has/hasn't just been mapped.

This is true for one iteration of the compositor's main loop immediately after the
window has been mapped.

tag.description: Matches the toplevel-tag of the window verbatim.

tag-regex.description: Matches the toplevel-tag of the window with a regular expression.

x-class.description: Matches the X class of the window verbatim.

x-class-regex.description: Matches the X class of the window with a regular expression.

x-instance.description: Matches the X instance of the window verbatim.

x-instance-regex.description: Matches the X instance of the window with a regular expression.

x-role.description: Matches the X role of the window verbatim.

x-role-regex.description: Matches the X role of the window with a regular expression.

workspace.description: Matches the workspace of the window verbatim.

workspace-regex.description: Matches the workspace of the window with a regular expression.

content-types.description: Matches windows whose content type is contained in the mask.

is-workspace-container.description:
Matches if the window is/isn't the container of a workspace.

The workspace container is the outermost container of a workspace. It is
created when the first window is tiled on the workspace and it is the only
container whose parent is the workspace itself.

WindowMatchExactly.description: Criterion for matching a specific number of window criteria.

num.description: The number of criteria that must match.

anyOf.description: An array of masks that are OR'd.
